headline: Weathered Expanse Leads as Marban Hollow Quickens
war_summary: Three hours since the last edition, Marban Hollow provides the sharpest quickening with seven changes in the last two hours toward thirty in the day at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, now divided four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral, while Olavis Wake remains at the cutoff with five late changes toward thirty in the day around Koskinla, Ilmari Bridge and Iltaku, all five bases held Colonial. Weathered Expanse continues the heaviest traffic with four late changes toward fifty-five in the day around Spirit Watch, Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, now one Warden, five Colonial and three neutral. Kuura Strand stirs anew with two late changes toward nineteen in the day at Menneen and Faden Point, and Pari Peak and Stlican Shelf add one late change apiece toward twenty-seven and eleven in the day. Linn Mercy, Gutter and Nevish Line fall quiet in the last two hours despite eighteen, thirty-four and nine changes in the day, and Callahan's Passage, Stonecradle and the Deadlands still show heavy daily casualties without a recorded base change.
